name: PlaneAncor
summary:
Bring 3D models into your room with PlaneAncor for Meta Quest. Select a floor and two walls from Meta's saved room map to create a visible coordinate frame. Review models in stereo over passthrough, with clear plane outlines and optional sparse grids.

Import FBX, USD, USDA, USDC, USDZ, glTF, GLB, OBJ, STL and PLY. Folder import includes related files and textures. Models appear in front at their source scale. Use hands or Touch controllers to grab, move and rotate models; use two hands to rotate and scale.
